tasks.name: Model data with dataclasses and enums

concepts.name: functools.wraps in decorators
concepts.description: functools.wraps copies important metadata from the wrapped function and exposes __wrapped__, making decorators friendlier to introspection and tooling.

concepts.name: functools.cache and lru_cache
concepts.description: functools.cache memoizes calls without a size limit, while lru_cache(maxsize=...) bounds stored entries with least-recently-used eviction.

concepts.name: functools.partial
concepts.description: functools.partial creates a new callable with selected positional or keyword arguments pre-filled.

concepts.name: dataclass default_factory
concepts.description: dataclasses.field(default_factory=...) creates a fresh default value for each instance, avoiding shared mutable defaults.

concepts.name: dataclasses.replace
concepts.description: dataclasses.replace(instance, **changes) creates another instance of the same dataclass while changing selected fields.

concepts.name: Enum auto values
concepts.description: enum.auto() asks the Enum machinery to generate a member value; the generated value depends on the enum type and _generate_next_value_.

concepts.name: contextlib.contextmanager
concepts.description: @contextmanager turns a generator function with exactly one yield into a context manager whose setup runs before yield and cleanup runs afterward.

concepts.name: contextlib.suppress
concepts.description: contextlib.suppress(*exceptions) is a small context manager for intentionally ignoring specific exception types around a narrow operation.

concepts.name: contextlib.nullcontext
concepts.description: contextlib.nullcontext returns a context manager that performs no setup or cleanup, useful when code conditionally needs a real context manager.

questions.explanation: functools.wraps copies important metadata from the wrapped function and exposes __wrapped__, making decorators friendlier to introspection and tooling. questions.prompt: Memoize this pure recursive function without a size limit.
questions.explanation: functools.cache memoizes calls without a size limit, while lru_cache(maxsize=...) bounds stored entries with least-recently-used eviction. @cache is concise for pure computations with hashable arguments when unbounded growth is acceptable. Cached arguments must be hashable, and caching functions with side effects or time-varying results can return stale behavior.

questions.explanation: enum.auto() asks the Enum machinery to generate a member value; the generated value depends on the enum type and _generate_next_value_. questions.prompt: Turn this generator function into a context manager.
questions.explanation: @contextmanager turns a generator function with exactly one yield into a context manager whose setup runs before yield and cleanup runs afterward. Use try/finally around yield when cleanup must happen even if the with-body raises. A contextmanager generator must yield exactly once; forgetting yield or yielding multiple times breaks the protocol.

questions.prompt: Ignore only the expected missing-file error around unlink().

content.template:
from contextlib import suppress

with {{answer}}:
    path.unlink()

questions.explanation: contextlib.suppress(*exceptions) is a small context manager for intentionally ignoring specific exception types around a narrow operation. with suppress(FileNotFoundError): path.unlink() expresses that a missing file is acceptable. Keep suppress scopes narrow; broad exception suppression can hide programming errors and make failures difficult to diagnose.

questions.prompt: Use one with-statement whether input comes from a file or the already-open sys.stdin.

content.template:
from contextlib import nullcontext

cm = open(path) if path is not None else {{answer}}
with cm as stream:
    process(stream)

questions.explanation: contextlib.nullcontext returns a context manager that performs no setup or cleanup, useful when code conditionally needs a real context manager. cm = open(path) if path else nullcontext(sys.stdin) lets one with-statement handle owned and borrowed resources. nullcontext does not close or otherwise manage the object you pass as enter_result.
